name: Gasthof Acherkogel
beschreibung: The Gasthof Acherkogel is located in the region of Tirol in Österreich. The accommodation is set up as a hotel and offers a traditional atmosphere. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain landscape. Guests can expect comfortable amenities with a restaurant and rooms. The location is suitable for hiking and winter sports. The hotel is clean and functional. It serves as a base for exploring the region.
